desc:
🎨 Do you really know how your favorite anime looks like? So paint it right!

🤖 Every painting is scored by accuracy
❤️ Win rounds and take the match
⚡ Use power-ups to boost yourself or troll your rival
💵 Earn Cash, build your streak, and unlock chairs and cosmetics

Can you paint the anime character better than they paint you?

👍 Like the game and ⭐ favorite it to support future updates!
